CREATE TABLE "public"."agent_admissions" (
  "client_message_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (uuidv7()) NOT NULL,
  "identity_id" text NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "operation_id" text,
  "payer" text NOT NULL,
  "quota_refunded_at" timestamptz,
  "quota_reserved_at" timestamptz,
  "quota_usage_date" date,
  "rejection_reason" text,
  "request_digest" text NOT NULL,
  "session_id" text NOT NULL,
  "state" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "agent_admissions_anon_reservation_6033223e" CHECK (quota_reserved_at IS NULL OR (payer = 'anon' AND kind = 'model')),
  CONSTRAINT "agent_admissions_kind_c9a3d3de" CHECK (kind IN ('model', 'selection')),
  CONSTRAINT "agent_admissions_operation_eb16a5ca" CHECK ((kind = 'model') = (operation_id IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "agent_admissions_payer_e16f03f2" CHECK (payer IN ('anon', 'user', 'byok')),
  CONSTRAINT "agent_admissions_refund_01ca6412" CHECK (quota_refunded_at IS NULL OR quota_reserved_at IS NOT NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "agent_admissions_reservation_703b91eb" CHECK ((quota_usage_date IS NULL) = (quota_reserved_at IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "agent_admissions_state_68032317" CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'settled', 'void'))
)
